policy: RESEARCH_ONLY. Diocesan-site photo lane; institutes prefer emblem, hosted venues neutral. Source Commons/parish witness, exact physical building, licence/photographer and visual composition are separate release gates. Preview SHA mismatch against Wikimedia source original does not itself imply defective or unusable archived image; preserve derivative provenance. No new publication approval.
provenance: Derived from 13 owner-held ZIPs audited for image decoding and preview SHA256 in Ad_Orientem_TLM_157_Archived_Church_Photo_Recovery.zip; excludes 19 original-byte matches documented in independent source register; previous contact-sheet visual QA reconciled plus three additional low-priority composition warnings. Every individual archived preview SHA-256 and preview pixel dimensions are now cross-checked against all three original P739 audit-part registries.
verification: Metadata-based global triage plus reviewed seven photo contact sheets. Current Commons file-page licences and original-file SHA1 NOT revalidated for these 138 during this pass; archived licences are historical claims, not publication authorizations. No new original files downloaded. External photo record checks establish current Commons licence and original-file SHA1 for 3 specific files (Blandford, Cosham, Park City) and archive historic SHA1s match; 11 more have official or heritage site witnesses but their precise Commons file licence is not current-verified. One old building disqualified for current venue.
release_decision: Three source/license/site/image-checked previews advanced to editorial review (not approved/published); one historical wrong-current-venue image rejected; 11 building identities corroborated with licence pending. No new production publication approvals.
